# The playback ON/OFF override (menu 271) forces mode 2 while playing: in
# mode 1 and in mode 0, play 100..200 across the physics-off key of bone 髪2
# at frame 120.
settle 0
load pmm swing600.pmm
trace toggle.trace
physics mode 1
pump 3 33
physics playback toggle
play 100 200
pump 30 33
stop
pump 1 33
physics mode 0
pump 3 33
play 100 200
pump 30 33
stop
pump 1 33
physics playback toggle
save pmm toggle.pmm
